caption: The drawing features two main objects on a plain, off-white background. The object in the upper left section is a three-dimensional, metallic branding iron with a handle extending to the right. The branding iron's marking end forms a shape resembling the letter "H" with slightly curved and thickened ends, rendered in dark brown and rust colors that suggest a metallic texture and patina. Below and slightly to the right of the branding iron, there is a two-dimensional, flat depiction of the same "H" shape, colored in a lighter brown shade with a textured, fuzzy look, indicating the mark that the branding iron would leave. Both objects are shaded and detailed to clearly depict their forms and textures, arranged against a neutral, pale backdrop with no additional elements present.
title: Branding Iron
